checks.what: The results feed reproduces the official standings
checks.method: Sum every game in the feed per club and compare wins, losses, ties, points for and points against with the official nfl.com standings, cell by cell.
checks.result: 160 of 160 cells match across all 32 clubs

checks.what: The player log transcription matches the official season totals
checks.method: Every game row was transcribed from the official player log table, then the per-player column sums were compared with the official 2026 season totals published on the same page. A mistyped number breaks the sum.

checks.what: No closing price snapshot exists without an opening one
checks.method: Every record in the price store is inspected for a close without an open. The store refuses to write one.

checks.what: Every game in the feed carries an official source link
checks.method: Each row of the results feed is inspected for a source URL pointing at an nfl.com page.
checks.result: 137 of 137 games carry an official source link

checks.what: Every correlation is published with its sample size n
checks.method: Each correlation row is inspected for an n value.

checks.what: No market number is presented as an official number
checks.method: Every market block in the originated lines is inspected for its source kind.

checks.what: No depth cell is filled without an official source
checks.method: Every injury row is inspected for a filled replacement tier.
checks.result: 276 injury rows checked, 0 depth cells filled
